ownership.quote:
We've been building Brimble — a modern hosting platform for developers to ship fullstack apps easily.

It's just two of us. No funding. No marketing team.

stage.quote: It's just two of us. No funding. No marketing team.
stage.note: Founders explicitly said 'no funding' as of June 2025 (a Show HN post titled 'We bootstrapped a Vercel alternative – Brimble'). No YC/Crunchbase profile found (ycombinator.com/companies/brimble returns 404); no later funding announcement found. Team appears to be a small remote team based in Nigeria (careers page lists NGN salaries), consistent with a small bootstrapped company, but this could not be independently confirmed beyond the founders' own statement.

employees.source: https://brimble.io/careers — lists a small number of open roles (Sales Representative, Product Manager, Fullstack/Infra Engineer), all remote in Nigeria, paid in NGN; no total headcount stated

note: Brimble is a small, apparently bootstrapped PaaS/sandbox provider (per its own June 2025 Show HN post: 'It's just two of us. No funding.'). No YC listing, no Crunchbase/PitchBook profile found, and no press coverage of any funding round was found in the time available. The product has since expanded (full-stack app hosting, databases, object storage, sandboxes) and the team appears to have grown to a small remote team based in Nigeria (careers page salaries in NGN), but there is no evidence of institutional funding or an accelerator affiliation.
